verifyDocuments.subject: How to verify my ownership documents?

addProperty.question: How do I add a new property?
addProperty.answer: Go to My Properties and click the "Add Property" button. Fill in all the required details including photos, description, and pricing.

verifyIdentity.question: How to verify my identity?
verifyIdentity.answer: Navigate to Profile & Settings > Verification tab. Upload your National ID or Passport and Business License. Verification typically takes 1-2 business days.

paymentMethods.question: What are the payment methods?
paymentMethods.answer: Renters can pay via bank transfer. They upload payment proof which you then confirm from your Payment History page.

renterDisputes.question: How to handle renter disputes?
renterDisputes.answer: Use the Messages feature to communicate directly with your renter. If unresolved, submit a support ticket and our team will mediate.

rentalAgreements.question: How are rental agreements created?
rentalAgreements.answer: Once a renter expresses interest and you both agree on terms, an agreement is generated. Both parties sign digitally through the platform.

updateBankDetails.question: How to update my bank details?
updateBankDetails.answer: Go to Profile & Settings > Payment Details tab. Update your bank information and click Save. Changes take effect immediately.
